title: Regional Director, Food Safety and Quality Assurance
text:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

*We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.*

**SUMMARY:** The Regional Food Safety and Quality Assurance Director is responsible for ensuring company compliance with appropriate food safety laws and regulations including but not limited to FSIS, HACCP, SSOP and GMP requirements. Additionally, this position is responsible for ensuring company compliance with appropriate customer expectations regarding specifications, quality, procedures, or any special requirement

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** include, but are not limited to, the following:

* Demonstrate proficient knowledge of procedures currently written for monitoring processes on the production floor and ensure proper implementation and enforcement. This includes but is not limited to:
 + HACCP (Hazardous Analysis of Critical Control Points) integration into the facility
 + QA (Quality Assurance) procedures.
 + SSOP (Standard Sanitation Operating Procedures)
 + SOP (Standard Operating Procedures)
 + GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices)
 + Pre-Operation Inspection
 + Bone Elimination
 + Food Defense
* Provide day-to-day leadership for plant management regarding food safety regulations, procedures, and issues.
* Demonstrate a complete understanding of the HACCP, Food Defense and SSOP procedures as well as the regulatory process and supporting documents that are included.
* Possess a complete working knowledge of the Food Safety and Inspection Service (FSIS) regulations, implementing directives and other appropriate food safety guidance material that affects our plant and products.
* Oversee the implementation of any new food safety and/or quality procedures affecting the plant.
* Maintain plant and departmental records, report and log to ensure documentation and design controls are appropriate, and that record retention requirements are met.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**

This position will have supervisory responsibility.

**EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE**

* **Required**
 + Bachelor’s Degree in Food Science or related field or equivalent related experience AND 7+ years of experience in food processing, food safety & quality assurance OR 11+ years of progressively responsible FSQA related experience
 + Excellent interpersonal and communication skills – written and verbal
 + Proficient computer skills, especially in Microsoft applications (Excel, Power Point, Outlook etc.)
 + Working knowledge of Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP) management system required by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and the standards set by the Safe Quality Food Institute (SQFI)
* **Preferred**
 + Experience with Food Safety and Inspection Service (FSIS), Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) regulations
 + Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point (HACCP) Certification
 + ServSafe Basic Certification
 + Poultry experience
